verdict: Cadence grew revenue 22% to $1.63B and raised its full-year outlook, but stock pay, deal amortization and a restructuring charge held GAAP profit flat at $290M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — double-digit growth in every product category

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: flat YoY; non-GAAP EPS was $2.11, up from $1.93

kpis.label: Backlog
kpis.note: a record — orders booked but not yet delivered

kpis.label: Recurring revenue
kpis.note: subscription-style revenue, the stable core of sales

segments.name: Product & maintenance
segments.note: Chip-design software licenses (EDA tools) plus maintenance — Core EDA grew 20%, IP 24% and System Design & Analysis 30%.

segments.name: Services
segments.note: Design services and help getting Cadence tools running at customers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the design tools and the new AI 'Super Agents' — the biggest running cost, up 27% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing & sales
opex.note: Selling to chipmakers and systems companies — up 26% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — up 45% YoY, lifted by deal-related costs.

opex.name: Amortization of acquired intangibles
opex.note: Spreading the cost of technology bought in past acquisitions over its useful life — a non-cash charge.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: One-off restructuring costs booked in the quarter (see one-offs).

otherDetail: Interest expense of $30M, partly offset by $10M of other income — a net $20M cost below the operating line.
oneTimers: Restructuring cost $42M in the quarter, and amortization of acquired intangibles was $80M in total ($34M in operating expenses, the rest in cost of revenue) — both are excluded from Cadence's non-GAAP results.
Stock-based compensation — shares paid to employees — was $145M in the quarter. It is the main reason non-GAAP net income ($581M, $2.11 per share) is roughly double the GAAP figure.
footerNote: Figures are rounded to $M from amounts reported in thousands, so some lines differ by $1M from a straight rounding of the release (operating income $428M here vs $429M rounded; tax $118M vs $119M). Cost of revenue of $236M is cost of product & maintenance ($174M) plus cost of services ($62M).

takeaways.title: A record order book
takeaways.text: Backlog hit a record $8.2B, with $4.2B of revenue already contracted for the next 12 months. Management raised the 2026 outlook to 21% revenue growth and $8.40 of non-GAAP EPS.

takeaways.title: GAAP margin compressed
takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin fell to 26.2% from 31.8% as stock pay, acquisition amortization and restructuring grew faster than sales. On Cadence's non-GAAP basis the margin was 44.1%.

takeaways.title: Systems is the growth edge
takeaways.text: System Design & Analysis revenue grew 30%, IP 24% and Core EDA 20% — AI-driven chip design is pulling every category, and Cadence's hardware line had another record quarter.
